items.question: How accurate are Narxla’s prices?
items.answer: Prices come from open online stores and classifieds sites in Tashkent (Uzum Market, Prom.uz, Glotr.uz and others). Every estimate shows the price date, and the result is a range rather than a single number.

items.question: Is it only for Tashkent?
items.answer: For now, prices are collected for Tashkent. You can use it in other cities too, but prices may differ from the local market — other regions will be added later.

items.question: How are material quantities calculated?
items.answer: Doors and windows are subtracted from the wall area, the manufacturer’s consumption rate is applied to each material and a 10% reserve is added. For tile, cutting waste is included as well.

items.question: How does the contractor price check work?
items.answer: Enter the amount your contractor quoted. We compare it with the market range for that job type and area and show how far it is from the average.

items.question: What’s included in the free plan?
items.answer: 3 estimates, 25 material calculators, contractor quote checks and price ranges in UZS. Need the whole apartment, PDF and price tracking? The Project plan is a one-time 49 000 UZS.

items.question: Why not a monthly subscription?
items.answer: People renovate once every few years, so homeowners get no subscription. The Project plan is paid once, price tracking runs for 6 months, and your estimates stay available afterwards. Monthly Pro is only for contractors who build estimates every week — cancel anytime.
